about: Product-specific VST3 component floats, measured from public host APIs. Values are stored VST3 plain values, which need not equal displayed physical units. Component and controller envelopes, unknown float slots and private tails are retained. Parameter links give the component float slot; edits use these stored values, not normalized automation or display text.

layers: stored float32 controls and opaque tail

parameters/Delay Time Pan.about: Host display: -2 = Left: 400% / Right: 100%; -1 = Left: 200% / Right: 100%; 0 = Left: 100% / Right: 100%; 1 = Left: 100% / Right: 200%; 2 = Left: 100% / Right: 400%.

parameters/Pitch Shift.about: Host display: -1 = -12.000 semitones; -0.5 = -6.000 semitones; 0 = 0.000 semitones; 0.5 = 6.000 semitones; 1 = 12.000 semitones.

parameters/Wet Pan.about: Host display: -1 = Left: 0 dB / Right: -INF dB; -0.5 = Left: 0 dB / Right: -6.02 dB; 0 = Left: 0 dB / Right: 0 dB; 0.5 = Left: -6.02 dB / Right: 0 dB; 1 = Left: -INF dB / Right: 0 dB.
